text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear pro position in opening and closing","quality":"argument focus","description":"It states a consistent stance and keeps returning to the same claim that driverless cars should be developed."},{"evidence":"three-part counterargument then rebuttal structure","quality":"organization","description":"It has a more developed argumentative structure, with a concession to concerns and a response to them before concluding."},{"evidence":"references to fuel, wrecks, traffic jams, liability, entertainment, safety features","quality":"support development","description":"It uses more supporting details from the article to back up its position and explain why the cars would be beneficial."},{"evidence":"“although people question... there are endless possibilities”","quality":"persuasive conclusion","description":"Its conclusion more explicitly restates the argument and leaves the reader with a clearer sense of advocacy."},{"evidence":"“people wonder who is at fault-the driver or the manufacturer?” followed by explanation","quality":"counterargument handling","description":"It does a better job of acknowledging objections and addressing them directly instead of merely mentioning them."}]}
